project_context.name: Enterprise E-Invoicing Platform
project_context.description: Government Ready E-Invoicing Platform for Malaysia LHDN MyInvois. Features multi-tenant, RBAC, invoice lifecycle, dashboard, MyTax/MyInvois onboarding workflows, approval workflows.
project_context.design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Arch 4) fused with Linear/Stripe style restraint. Emphasis on data density, precise lines, and functional color usage.

theme.description: Toggle between Linear-inspired pitch-black dark mode and Stripe-inspired clean, crisp light mode.
rules: Use explicit color definitions for both modes via Tailwind dark: modifier or CSS variables.
Avoid muddy gray transparencies. Use optical clarity for frosted glass.
Never use pure #000000 or pure #ffffff for large text/background areas without a tint or contrast adjustment.

typography.strategy: The Old Money Tech + Soft Utility blend
rules: Do NOT use Inter for headings. Keep Manrope for headings to ensure an enterprise-friendly but distinct personality.
Line height must be tight (leading-none) for headers and loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
Use mono fonts for financial data, invoice IDs, and tax codes to ensure perfect vertical alignment.

colors.strategy: High contrast structural grayscale with purposeful semantic accents. Color exists to guide action and indicate status, not decorate.
rules: Interactive elements MUST have higher contrast on focus/hover.
Hover state color must be a lighter/darker hue of the active state color.
Status chips must use low-opacity backgrounds of their semantic color (e.g., bg-success/10 text-success) for readability.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode B - High Density) combined with generous padding on structural containers.

grid.dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard (p-4, p-6, p-8). Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6) to prevent text collision.
rules: Always override default stretch behavior on specific grid items that shouldn't stretch by using 'self-start'.
Use optical alignment over geometrical alignment for icons inside buttons.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow in dark mode, shadow-sm in light mode. Rounded corners (rounded-xl).
surfaces.glassmorphism: Used strictly for Sticky Headers, Floating Navs, and Command Palettes. Light mode: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5. Dark mode: bg-[#0A0A0B]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5.
surfaces.neumorphism: Avoided. Stick to Flat/Crisp enterprise aesthetic.
rules: CRITICAL: Never use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays over content. Always use glassmorphism with blur.
Modal overlays must have a dark scrim (bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm) behind the crisp surface.

components.navigation: Sidebar for primary enterprise navigation (collapsible). Sticky glassmorphic top header for context (Company Switcher, Profile, Search).
components.tables: Shadcn based. Must include column chooser dropdown, sticky header, row selection checkboxes, and horizontal scrolling for dense data. Use Mono font for numbers.
components.status_chips: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Padding px-2.5 py-0.5. Bold text. Validated (Green), Rejected (Red), Draft (Gray), Pending (Yellow).
components.command_palette: Cmd+K triggered. Centered modal. Glassmorphic overlay. Quick actions for 'Create Invoice', 'Search Customer', 'Switch Company'.
components.timeline: Vertical line indicator for Audit Trails and Invoice Lifecycle. Use relative positioning, border-l-2 border-border/50, and absolute positioned dots.
components.forms: Progressive disclosure via Accordions or Tabs. Inline validation. Floating action bar at bottom of the form for Save/Submit actions.
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Line/Bar combinations. Ensure grid lines are subtle (opacity-10). Use the palette's accent/success colors.

motion.strategy: Micro-interactions for feedback. Restrained and professional.
rules: Buttons/Cards: active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform duration-200.
Hover states: opacity transition for text, subtle background shifts.
Skeletons: Use pulse animation (animate-pulse) with a subtle muted background block for loading states.
Do NOT use 'transition-all'. Target specific properties: transition-colors, transition-opacity, transition-transform.

assets.icons: lucide-react for consistent, clean 24x24 or 16x16 vector icons.
rules: Use avatars for multi-user representations and RBAC tables.
Use the company logo image for the multi-tenant switcher.
Normal text must meet 4.5:1 contrast. Large text 3:1.
ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
Focus rings are mandatory: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-accent.
CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, table rows) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-invoice-btn').

general_ui_ux_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break out of it by using strict bento grids, glassmorphism, and precise border utility usage.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Keep surfaces flat or use subtle radial gradients at the top of the body for lighting.
Never center align the App container. Maintain a left-aligned, enterprise-grade reading flow.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings, active scaling).
Use 2x spacing for section gaps (e.g., py-12 or py-16) to avoid cramped layouts.
Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications. Ensure it is styled to match the dark/light modes.
Never use AI emoji characters (like brain, robot, crystal ball) for icons. Use Lucide icons.
instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: This project uses React + Vite + Javascript (.js/.jsx), NOT Typescript. Write all components in Javascript and adapt Shadcn UI blocks to pure Javascript.
Do NOT build generic boring admin pages. Refer to the 'Linear/Stripe' design mandate: sparse, crisp borders, dark/light mode execution.
Implement the Mock Adapter for Malaysia LHDN MyInvois seamlessly, updating the Timeline component as statuses change.
Build the dashboard using CSS Grid (Bento style). Inject skeleton loaders for all widgets before data mounts.
Implement a Command Palette (Cmd+K) using a dialog with a search input and list of actions.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize their border radius and border colors to match this guideline.
Remember to include data-testid on EVERY interactive element.
Use React Context or Zustand for the multi-tenant company switcher state and Dark Mode toggling.
